+title: 'docs/marketplaces.md: remove the catalog-file text that Extras 8c7acc1 made false'
+---
+## What
+Extras commit `8c7acc1` ("feat(marketplace)!: load skills and agents by folder scan, remove catalog files") removed catalog files. The Extras README says: "A marketplace is only a folder. The store reads no catalog file". `docs/marketplaces.md` still describes catalog files.
+
+Stale sections in `docs/marketplaces.md`:
+- `## Catalog formats`: names `.claude-plugin/marketplace.json`, `.agents/plugins/marketplace.json`, the plugin `skills` array, and the `renames` map.
+- `## Skill selection`: names `.plugins([…])` and "every skill of the catalog".
+- The `select` row of the `MarketplaceSource` field table names `.plugins([…])`.
+- `## Publish a marketplace`: tells the publisher to write a catalog, a plugin with an explicit `skills` array, and a `metadata.version`.
+
+Found during ^nw738g3. That task corrected only the display id and the provenance text.
+
+## Work
+1. Read the Extras `Sources/Marketplace` at the resolved revision (`SkillSelection.swift`, `MarketplaceLayout.swift`, the folder scan) and the Extras README marketplace section.
+2. Rewrite each stale section of `docs/marketplaces.md` to match the folder-scan behavior. Remove each claim that the store reads a catalog file.
+3. Search `README.md` and `docs/` again for `marketplace.json`, `plugins`, and `catalog` and correct each claim that is false.
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+- [ ] No text in `README.md` or `docs/` says that the store reads a catalog file.
+- [ ] `swift build` and `swift test` pass.
\ No newline at end of file
